name: Duvet 200 × 210
notes: Generic duvet, not a specific product: 200 × 210 cm, the Swiss size for a 160 cm bed, made up over a 160 × 200 mattress (bed-boxspring-160x200). It covers the whole mattress, 6 cm thick, and hangs 14 cm down the sides and the foot; the item's box (165 × 205 cm) is the duvet as it lies on the bed, 2.5 cm wider than the mattress on each side. Drop it on the bed: it is centred and lies square on it. Its top is a surface for the pillows (pillow-65x65) and the bedspread (bedspread-quilted-240x260), which then move with it. On a 150 cm bed (bed-boxspring-150x200-headboard) it is 7.5 cm wider than the mattress on each side.
